0022600040.text: The San Antonio Spurs, 9-2 and 1st in the Southwest, host the Golden State Warriors, who are 8-3 and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. The Spurs are 5-0 on the road and 4-2 at home and have won nine straight, while the Warriors are 6-1 at home and 2-2 on the road and have won eight straight. The Spurs are without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the Warriors are without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Stephen Curry listed as day-to-day with abdominal soreness and a game-time decision; the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, with the Spurs winning 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, and they have not met yet this season.
